title: SPEC.md front matter
description: The spec-wide contract: format version, the verification policy every task inherits, the gates with their commands, the references tasks cite, and the tasks the folder does not contain (preconditions).

format.description: The format version; selects this schema set.

policy.description: The verification policy every task in the spec inherits.

gates.description: Build and quality checks, keyed by gate id.

refs.description: Decisions, findings, assumptions and standards, keyed by namespaced ref id; one statement each.

outside.description: Tasks of this spec that the folder does not contain, id to title. Each one is a precondition: a task or scenario that depends on it waits until the state store records it as trusted (R12).

title.description: What the gate checks, in a few words.

command.description: The executable command; exit code 0 passes the gate.

requires.description: The environment the command needs, for example a runtime version.

redFirst.description: A failing test for each ensures obligation lands before the change that makes it pass.

proofBinding.description: A test proves an id when its title starts with `[<qualified id>]`.

structural.description: A task's commits change only its declared touches, plus tests.

review.description: One independent review of each parent's combined diff once all its children are trusted.

trust.description: An independent verifier, never the builder, judges every proof.

acceptance.description: A scenario is judged once every task it needs is trusted.

evidence.description: What a proof run must record.

budgets.description: Retry limits before the engine stops and reports.

judges.description: Who judges each proof kind; an obligation's judges are derived from its proof kind.
